svg.title: Systems That Create Leverage
svg.desc: Systems That Create Leverage. I am drawn to tools that multiply what a person can do: Saves time, Clarifies decisions, Automates repetitive work, Helps people learn faster, Makes complex tasks easier, Turns knowledge into action, Gives individuals more power to create. They change what people are capable of doing.

g.text: I am drawn to tools that multiply what a person can do.
The kind of software that interests me is software that:
Gives individuals more power to create
To me, the most exciting products are not just convenient.
They change what people are capable of doing.
